_help: Copy this folder to Companies/<MNCs|Product|Service|Startups>/<Sub>/<CompanyName>/company.json. Folders starting with _ are ignored. Only companyName is required.
notes: ats is optional: it is detected from careersUrl for Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters. Any other careersUrl is read via Firecrawl, and only listings verified on the page are kept. For SmartRecruiters add "country": "in" to ats so large global boards return only India postings.
